description: Evaluation-only pre-write safety check. Verifies the AnchorID exists, confidence meets threshold, no unresolved conflicts, and at least one canonical link is present. Returns allowed/blocked with reasons. This tool does NOT perform any write — the caller decides whether to proceed.

entity_id.description: UUID of the AnchorID to evaluate

require_no_conflicts.description: Block if unresolved conflicts exist (default: true)

name: guard_write
